new_value: Four FIFO lanes share two relay buffers, separate device latches, a free list and detached final-transfer slots. Direct ARAM modes also reserve a relay slot. The DVD scanner can pass a relay-blocked earlier lane for a later direct request. Result -1 latches a global DVD error with no local reset, suppressing ordinary DVD notification without stopping chunking/ARAM posting. Cancellation is cooperative and some removal paths do not recycle. IsBusy observes lane occupancy only; type, priority and callback reentry contracts are not enforced completely.
